article.title: After 50, This Is The ONLY Bra I Recommend.
article.intro1: As a bra designer with over 30 years of experience, most of my clients today are women in their 50s, 60s, 70s and 80s. They keep telling me the same thing: “The bras I used to love don't feel right anymore.” So when I kept hearing about the EBRA Wireless Bra from women over 50, I decided to put it to the test… and I'm so glad I did.
article.imgLifestyle1: Lifestyle photo · woman 65–70 wearing Shapermint at home · warm, candid, smiling · NOT staged
article.intro2: First time on, I knew. **This is the one.**
article.intro3: No wire digging. No band rolling up. No relief at 6pm because I forgot it was on.
article.intro4: It fits the body I have now — not the one I had at 30. And it's become the **#1 wirefree bra for women over 50**, with over 1 million sold.

article.s1Heading: Your Body Changed. Your Bra Should Too.
article.s1p1: At 30, underwires were comfortable. At 60? They're the first thing you take off.
article.s1p2: That's not your fault. After menopause, tissue softens. Skin thins. Shapes shift. So your breast shape starts changing — and most bras are still made for the body you had 30 years ago.
